items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Of course, Dan Grissom was the vocalist. And out of us four guys I don't think any of us could really sing... Dan Grissom was really the true vocalist with the group

ctx.x: I know you mentioned yesterday that the time you were in Chicago that -- we were talking about John Collins. You said John Collins was playing with --

John was over at a barbershop at the back of -- I think it was in the back of a barbershop his mother used to play. And Dan Grissom was singing with them. I don't know if he was singing regularly with them, but I know
